story.title: Be your best self.
paragraphs: Hi! I'm [Name], and I founded BYTEEX with one simple idea: getting dressed should feel as good as winding down.
We create thoughtful, comfortable essentials with soft fabrics and considered details, so the pieces you reach for every day are made with care.
From our fabric choices to the way each piece is finished, comfort and responsibility guide every decision we make.
We hope you find a new favorite here.

items.question: What makes your loungewear so comfortable?
items.answer: Our signature fabric feels soft against your skin, with relaxed shapes designed for everyday comfort — whether you are spending the day at home or winding down for the night.

items.question: How do I choose my outfit?
items.answer: Explore the collection gallery to find your favorite color and style. Use the arrows or select a thumbnail to take a closer look at each outfit.

items.question: Where can I see the available styles?
items.answer: The collection gallery above features our White Robe, Oat Set, Sage Set and Relaxed Set.

items.question: Is the packaging kept simple?
items.answer: We skip wasteful extras like tags and plastic packaging, keeping the focus on the pieces you will wear.

items.question: Is free shipping available?
items.answer: Free shipping is available on orders over $200.

items.question: What is the return window?
items.answer: There is a 45 day return window, giving you time to find your comfortable fit.

closing.title: Find something you love.
closing.description: Soft essentials for slow mornings, cozy evenings, and everything in between. Make yourself comfortable.
